written.headline: Anthropic IPO set to deliver windfall to smaller VC firms
written.summary: Anthropic's upcoming IPO is poised to generate multibillion-dollar returns for venture firms and tech companies that backed the Claude maker, with smaller firms like Spark Capital and Iconiq set for outsized gains. Iconiq's stake is worth about $17 billion at the company's $965 billion private valuation, and Spark Capital's $75 million investment is now worth $7 billion.

written.headline: San Francisco AI insiders could hold $1.2 trillion in equity as Anthropic goes public
written.summary: San Francisco AI startup insiders are estimated to hold $1.2 trillion in equity, led by Anthropic, which is set to go public at an expected $1.4 trillion valuation.

written.headline: Sarvam AI launches Token Factory hosting mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, reigniting sovereign AI debate
written.summary: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory on November 16, an inference platform serving eight open-weight models through a single OpenAI-compatible API on GPU clusters in India. Six of the eight models are from Chinese companies, while Sarvam received a ₹98.68 crore government GPU subsidy to build indigenous foundation models.

written.headline: Researchers find vision-language models give harmful help from scene images
written.summary: Researchers led by Tongxi Wu identified a "scene-state safety vulnerability" in which vision-language models provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit harmful request. Their attack method S3TA achieved a model-average attack success rate of 71.2% across eight VLMs, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points.

written.headline: Researchers propose ATI, a security layer for cross-organization AI agents
written.summary: Viet K. Nguyen and Mohammad I. Husain published a paper proposing the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture for verifying identity, integrity, and authorization of AI agents operating across organizations. In their simulated eight-organization federation, enabling ATI's enforcement mechanisms increased attack containment from 43% to 84% with about 174 microseconds of overhead per request.

written.headline: LanceDB raises $57.5M Series B to expand multimodal AI lakehouse
written.summary: LanceDB raised $57.5 million in Series B funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Innovation Endeavors to expand its multimodal lakehouse for AI training data. The round brings total funding to $98.5 million.

written.headline: Sarvam AI hosts six Chinese models in India, reigniting sovereign AI debate
written.summary: Sarvam AI's Token Factory, launched November 16, offers eight AI models through a single OpenAI-compatible API on Indian GPU servers, but six of the eight are built by Chinese companies. The mix has reopened debate over whether a startup backed by the IndiaAI Mission should prioritise indigenous models or make the world's best models accessible in India.
